hints.title: Check Small Request Count
hints.text: The number of transfer requests is at most 16, allowing power set iteration.

hints.title: Net Degree Invariance
hints.text: For a chosen subset of transfers, each building outgoing count must match incoming count.

hints.title: Bitmask or Backtracking
hints.text: Iterate over all bitmasks of requests, tally net change per building, and take the maximum popcount.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy request selection fails because requests can form arbitrary cycle networks across buildings.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since m <= 16, testing all 2^16 subsets executes in under 100 milliseconds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice m <= 16 constraint and immediately formulate a bitmask or recursive search.
